chapter: Los Angeles: Roy Milton and Central Avenue
title: Bus breakdown near Cheyenne and leaving Fields
summary: The bus broke down in a freezing Wyoming winter, so he left Fields and called Roy Milton to return to California.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: So we were headed into Denver coming from out of Seattle. And we came through Cheyenne, Wyoming. And about twelve miles north of Cheyenne, the bus broke down. Now, this is like early February. The bus broke down up on this mountain. [LAUGHS] And as far as you could see, it was nothing but white. And it was cold, cold, cold... In fact, if you moved any kind of way, you got colder. You know? I said, "Boy, if I ever get off this mountain, this is it!" So they managed to get... Some people came through and they managed to take us down to a little train station, where at least they had a heater in there. So we...some of us... So we went up to the train station. And the next morning... We just sat in there, trying to keep warm, you see.

And the next morning, they managed to get that bus down off that mountain, and we headed into Denver. So we played Denver. And I think our next stop was Dodge City, Kansas. And so I said, "This is it." Because I had caught a very bad cold up on that mountain. And I said, "Well, if I go back East in all of this cold weather, I might just go into bad health with this kind of a cold," you know. So I thought it over, and I said, "Wow, I'd better get on back to California" -- and knowing that I had a job that I could go to. So I got on the phone and called Roy Milton, and he said, "Yeah, come on back," you know. And I talked to Ernie about it, and he could see my point, and he wished me the best of everything, and all the guys... They hated to see me go, because we had a... You know, I had really become like another family, you know!
